title: 'Discard a gear' cost is not enforced or paid
expected: Sky Cruiser's runtime ability cost (verified via getAllCards) is `{discard:{amount:1,cardType:"gear"}, energy:1, exhaust:true}` — the parser emits an object shape at packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/activated.ts:227. The engine only handles `cost.discard` as a number: activate-ability.ts:715-716 (condition) and :1068-1071 (enumerator) do `discardCost && discardCost > 0`, which is false for an object, so no hand-size/gear gating and no discardId enumeration; there is also no cardType filter anywhere. In the reducer (activate-ability.ts:1272-1291 then 1324-1327) energy/exhaust are paid, then `if (cost.discard) { if (!discardId) return; }` early-returns without trashing anything. Matches observed: activatable with no gear, no discard prompt, gear stays in hand.
observed: activateAbility was offered and accepted with zero gear in hand; with Spirit's Refuge (gear) in hand, activation still discarded nothing (gear stayed in hand, trash unchanged, no discard prompt, no discardId param enumerated)
